register.labelZh: CONTRACT 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: contract in 和 contract into 可以描述正式選擇加入公司退休金計劃或其他官方制度。；contract out 和 contract out of 可以描述某人正式決定不加入或不再參加某項官方計劃。；contract something out 可以表示公司安排外部機構承辦某項工作。；這些表達可以出現在公司表格、退休金資料、會議和商業服務的討論中。
register.summaryEn: Contract in and contract into help you describe the formal decision to join a company pension plan or another official system. Contract out and contract out of help you describe someone’s formal decision not to join or remain in an official plan. Contract something out explains that a company has arranged for an outside business to perform a job. These expressions may appear in company forms, pension information, meetings and discussions about business services.

說明不參加計劃的決定
描述由外部公司承辦的工作
contextsEn: Talk clearly about joining workplace plans
Explain the choice not to take part
Describe work done by an outside company

fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Contract in and contract out can be used alone when the plan or system is already clear: Employees can contract in. Employees may contract out. When the plan is named, use: contract into the pension scheme contract out of the pension scheme Work can appear in either of these positions: contract the cleaning out contract out the cleaning With it or them, place the word in the middle: contract it out contract them out
